dmr.ability.cherry.name: Cherry Blessing
dmr.ability.cherry.description: Every 25 seconds the cherry dragon heals its owner if the owner has full health it gives him 2 and a half hearts of absorption
dmr.ability.deer.name: Satiation Aura
dmr.ability.deer.description: This dragon will regenerate its owner's hunger when he is close to it
dmr.ability.sculk.name: Wisdom Surge
dmr.ability.sculk.description: Every 25 seconds the sculk dragon gives experience to the owner if he is riding the dragon
dmr.ability.soul_sand.name: Slowing Aura
dmr.ability.soul_sand.description: Every 4 seconds slows all mobs around the dragon except for players
dmr.ability.jack_lantern.name: Horrifying Presence
dmr.ability.jack_lantern.description: This dragon produces terror to the mobs around him causing them to run away
dmr.ability.warped.name: Warped Shield
dmr.ability.warped.description: Destroys any enemy projectile that approaches it
dmr.ability.specter.name: Specter Attack
